coefficient_basis.why: An association ranking sets the allocation two seasons later, so the ranking finished at the end of 2024-25 drives 2026-27.
coefficient_basis.quote: For the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League, the associations were allocated places according to their 2025 UEFA association coefficients ... which took into account their performance in European competitions from 2020-21 to 2024-25.
coefficient_basis.formula_quote: The number of points awarded each season is divided by the number of teams that participated for that association in that season. ... To determine an association's coefficient for a particular season, the coefficients for the last five seasons are added.
coefficient_basis.note: Do not confuse this with the live 5-year table on the UEFA_coefficient page (2022-23..2026-27, feeding 2028-29). That snapshot has Portugal 6th and Netherlands 8th; the 2026-27 access list has Netherlands 6th and Portugal 7th. Same source family, different window.

ucl_winner.rule: Champions League winner gets a league-phase berth if not already qualified through the domestic league.
ucl_winner.quote: The winners of the 2025-26 UEFA Champions League and 2025-26 UEFA Europa League were each given an additional entry if they did not qualify for the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League through their domestic league.
ucl_winner.actual_2026_27: Paris Saint-Germain qualified as Ligue 1 champions, so the slot was rebalanced (see rebalancing).

uel_winner.rule: Europa League winner gets a Champions League league-phase berth if not already qualified through the domestic league.
uel_winner.actual_2026_27: Aston Villa qualified 4th in the Premier League, so the slot was rebalanced.

uecl_winner.rule: Conference League winner gets a Europa League league-phase berth if not already qualified for the Champions League or Europa League.
uecl_winner.quote: The title holders of the 2025-26 UEFA Conference League received an entry into the Europa League (if they did not qualify for the Champions League or Europa League via league position).
uecl_winner.actual_2026_27: Crystal Palace entered the Europa League league phase as CON.

eps.rule: One extra Champions League league-phase berth for each of the two associations with the best single-season (2025-26) association coefficient.
eps.quote: The two associations with the best coefficients in the 2025-26 season each have one European Performance Spot into the league phase. ... The winners of the UEFA Champions League and Europa League could not fill the European Performance Spots.
eps.computation_quote: From the 2023-24 season and onward, the two highest annual coefficients are used to determine two additional European Performance Spots (one per association) in the Champions League for the next season.
eps.season_coefficient_formula: (points earned by all of the association's clubs in that one season, bonus points included) / (number of clubs that association entered), truncated to three decimals
actual_2026_27: England - the extra berth went to 5th (Liverpool)
Spain - the extra berth went to 5th (Real Betis)
eps.note: The EPS is an extra berth on top of the association's normal allocation, so every league position below it slides down one and the association's 5th-placed team ends up in the Champions League league phase.

rebalancing.rule: When a title holder is already qualified its berth is not wasted: the best-coefficient club still in the qualifying rounds is pulled into the league phase and the hole behind it is filled from the round below.

entries.quote: as the domestic champions with the highest club coefficient among the clubs that would otherwise have entered the Champions Path of the qualifying phase or play-off round, entered the league phase instead of the Champions Path second qualifying round.
as the two clubs with the highest club coefficient that would otherwise have entered the Champions Path first qualifying round, entered the Champions Path second qualifying round.

as the club with the highest club coefficient among all clubs that would otherwise have entered either the Champions Path or the League Path of the qualifying phase or play-off round, entered the league phase instead of the League Path third qualifying round.
as the two clubs with the highest club coefficient that would otherwise have entered the League Path second qualifying round, entered the League Path third qualifying round.

rebalancing.knock_on: Every promotion leaves a hole filled from the round below, so the league phase stays at 36 and every qualifying round stays even. Loser counts in drop_downs are post-rebalancing.

traps: Use the coefficient snapshot that matches the season, not the live one. The 2026-27 access list uses the ranking finished at the end of 2024-25; the live 2026-27 table on the UEFA_coefficient page feeds 2028-29.
Russia is 26th with 0 teams. Do not allocate its berth: the slot is absorbed by pushing the association-23 champion up a round.
Liechtenstein has no league and no Champions League entrant: exactly one club, the cup winner, into UECL Q2.

Team numbers per association are fixed first; the entry round is what moves. A cup winner already qualified for the Champions League frees its Europa League slot, and it cascades down the league table.

Round names are path-specific. There is no single UEL Q3: it is Q3 Champions Path (12) plus Q3 Main Path (14). UECL Q2/Q3/play-off each split into Champions Path and League Path (the same path is called Main Path in some sections of the same page).
Champions Path losers from UCL Q3 go to the Europa League play-off round, but League Path losers from the same UCL Q3 go straight to the Europa League league phase. Same round, different destination.
UCL Q1 losers do not all land in UECL Q2: the published list gave two of them a bye to UECL Q3 Champions Path because the Champions Path above them had been thinned by rebalancing.
A cup runner-up gets nothing unless the winner's slot cascades.
source_quality: All four pages are Wikipedia 2026-27 season articles, each citing the UEFA club competition regulations for that season. No documents.uefa.com PDF was retrieved (the guessed UEFA access-list URL returned 404). Quotes are transcriptions with wiki link markup stripped and en dashes written as hyphens; ellipses mark omitted text inside a row. The UCL association table renders its Teams column unreliably after conversion, so per-association ucl_teams values come from the prose allocation bullets, not from that column.
